title: Weird Algorithm
hint: Follow the rule literally; consider the type of every intermediate value.

title: Missing Number
hint: Compare the expected sum with the observed sum.

title: Repetitions
hint: Track the run ending at the current character.

title: Increasing Array
hint: Fix each value as little as possible while preserving a valid prefix.

title: Bit Strings
hint: Each position has two choices; compute the power without constructing strings.

title: Trailing Zeros
hint: Count factors of 5; factors of 2 are more plentiful.

title: Distinct Numbers
hint: Equal values become neighbors after sorting.

title: Apartments
time: O(n log n + m log m)
hint: Sort both sides and match the smallest remaining compatible pair.

title: Ferris Wheel
hint: Place the heaviest remaining person; try the lightest as a partner.

title: Movie Festival
hint: Choose the compatible movie that finishes earliest.

title: Maximum Subarray Sum
hint: What is the best nonempty subarray ending exactly here?

title: Factory Machines
hint: Can a fixed amount of time produce at least the target?

title: Playlist
hint: Move the left boundary beyond the previous occurrence of a repeated song.

title: Subarray Sums II
hint: A subarray sum is the difference of two prefix sums.

title: Dice Combinations
hint: Classify a sequence by its last die roll.

title: Minimizing Coins
hint: Try each possible final coin for an exact sum.

title: Coin Combinations II
hint: Make the coin type the outer loop to avoid counting reorderings.

title: Book Shop
hint: Each book is available once; protect the previous layer while updating in place.

title: Edit Distance
hint: Relate two prefixes by the last insertion, deletion, or replacement.

title: Increasing Subsequence
hint: For each subsequence length, retain the smallest possible final value.

title: Counting Rooms
hint: Every room is one connected component of floor cells.

title: Building Teams
hint: Assign alternating teams as you traverse every connected component.

title: Shortest Routes I
hint: Always expand the smallest unsettled distance.

title: Road Reparation
hint: Add the cheapest edge that joins two different components.

title: Course Schedule
hint: A course is ready when no unfinished prerequisite remains.

title: Static Range Sum Queries
hint: Precompute the sum before every boundary.

title: Dynamic Range Sum Queries
hint: Store sums of power-of-two blocks, then update only blocks containing the changed index.

title: Dynamic Range Minimum Queries
hint: Each node stores the minimum of its interval; queries combine disjoint covered intervals.

title: String Matching
hint: After a mismatch, preserve the longest useful suffix of what already matched.

title: Watermelon
hint: Both pieces must be positive and even.

title: Way Too Long Words
hint: Keep the first and last characters and count only the interior.

title: Team
hint: Convert the agreement rule into a threshold on three binary values.

title: Next Round
hint: Read the score at rank k, then apply both eligibility conditions.

title: Frog 1
hint: The final jump came from one of the previous two stones.

title: Frog 2
hint: Generalize Frog 1: enumerate every permitted final jump.

title: Vacation
hint: Remember yesterday’s activity, because it determines today’s legal choices.

title: Permutations
hint: Separate the numbers by parity and examine the boundary.

title: Number Spiral
hint: The larger coordinate determines the square layer; parity determines its direction.

title: Two Knights
hint: Count all pairs of squares, then subtract attacking pairs.

title: Two Sets
hint: A partition exists only when the total is even; build one half from large numbers downward.

title: Palindrome Reorder
hint: All characters except possibly the center must occur in pairs.

title: Coin Piles
hint: Solve for the number of moves of each type.

title: Gray Code
hint: XOR each binary index with itself shifted one bit right.

title: Tower of Hanoi
hint: Move the smaller tower away, move the largest disk, then rebuild on it.

title: Creating Strings
hint: Start with the smallest arrangement and repeatedly request the next lexicographic permutation.

title: Apple Division
hint: With at most twenty apples, enumerate which ones belong to the first group.

title: Chessboard and Queens
hint: Place one queen in each row and reject occupied columns and diagonals early.

title: Digit Queries
hint: Skip complete blocks of one-digit, two-digit, and longer numbers.

title: Concert Tickets
hint: Find the largest remaining price that does not exceed each budget.

title: Restaurant Customers
hint: Translate each visit into an arrival and a departure event.

title: Stick Lengths
hint: A median minimizes the sum of absolute distances.

title: Missing Coin Sum
hint: Maintain the entire interval of sums already known to be constructible.

title: Collecting Numbers
hint: Look at the positions of consecutive values rather than repeatedly scanning the array.

title: Towers
hint: Put each cube on the smallest tower top that is strictly larger.

title: Traffic Lights
hint: Inserting one light splits exactly one existing interval into two.

title: Tasks and Deadlines
hint: The deadline sum is fixed; minimize the sum of completion times.

title: Reading Books
hint: Compare the total reading time with twice the longest single book.

title: Nearest Smaller Values
hint: Discard earlier candidates that are at least as large as the current value.

title: Coin Combinations I
hint: Classify each ordered sequence by its last coin.

title: Removing Digits
hint: For each number, try every nonzero digit as the first subtraction.

title: Grid Paths I
hint: A path enters each open cell from above or from the left.

title: Array Description
hint: Track how many valid prefixes end at each possible value.

title: Rectangle Cutting
hint: Consider every possible first horizontal or vertical cut.

title: Money Sums
time: O(n S), S = sum of coins
hint: Record which sums can be formed after each coin; each physical coin is usable once.

title: Two Sets II
hint: Count only the half of each partition that does not contain n.

title: Projects
hint: Sort by finishing day. For each project, find the last prefix that finishes before it begins.

title: Shortest Routes II
hint: Use each vertex in turn as an allowed intermediate vertex.

title: Flight Discount
hint: The same city has two states: coupon available and coupon already used.

title: Road Construction
hint: Maintain connected components as sets, merging only when the new edge joins different sets.

title: Game Routes
hint: Process vertices after all of their incoming contributions are known.

title: Labyrinth
hint: Breadth-first search finds shortest paths when every move costs one.

title: Subordinates
hint: A manager's subtree contains the manager plus every direct report's subtree.

title: Tree Diameter
hint: Walk as far as possible from any vertex, then as far as possible from that endpoint.

title: Tree Distances I
hint: Find a diameter. For any vertex, one of its endpoints is a farthest vertex.

title: Company Queries I
hint: Precompute ancestors at distances 1, 2, 4, 8, and so on.

title: Range Xor Queries
hint: XORing a value with itself cancels it.

title: Range Update Queries
hint: A range addition becomes two point changes in a difference array.

title: Finding Borders
hint: Once the longest border is known, find shorter borders inside that border.

title: Finding Periods
hint: A period p works exactly when the suffix beginning at p matches the prefix for all remaining characters.

title: Exponentiation
hint: Write the exponent in binary and repeatedly square the base.

title: Counting Divisors
time: O(M log M + n), M = max input
hint: Instead of factoring each query, let each divisor visit all its multiples.

title: Common Divisors
time: O(M log M + n), M = max input
hint: A candidate divisor works if at least two input occurrences are multiples of it.

title: Exponentiation II
hint: For a nonzero base modulo a prime, exponents may be reduced modulo prime-1.

title: Bit++
hint: Both spellings of an increment have the same middle character.

title: Domino Piling
hint: Each domino covers two cells. Can the area upper bound always be attained?

title: Petya and Strings
hint: Normalize letter case before comparing the strings.

title: Tram
hint: Track the current occupancy and its maximum after each stop.

title: Helpful Maths
hint: Separate the digits from the separators, sort, then rebuild the expression.

title: Word Capitalization
hint: Only the first character needs a case conversion.

title: Word
hint: Compare how many edits would be needed for an all-uppercase or all-lowercase word.

title: Soldier and Bananas
hint: The prices form a multiple of 1+2+...+w.

title: Wrong Subtraction
hint: Apply the stated rule to the current last digit at every step.

title: Elephant
hint: Each step advances at most five positions.

title: Knapsack 1
hint: The capacity bound is small enough to index the DP by available weight.

title: Knapsack 2
time: O(n V), V = sum of values
hint: Weight is too large to index, but the total value is bounded by 100,000.

title: LCS
hint: Compute optimal lengths for pairs of prefixes, then trace decisions backward.

title: Longest Path
hint: In a DAG, process each vertex only after all its predecessors.

title: Grid 1
hint: Combine paths arriving from above and left, treating walls as zero-count cells.

title: Coins
hint: Track a probability distribution over the number of heads after each toss.

title: Stones
hint: A position is winning if some move hands the opponent a losing position.

title: Boy or Girl
hint: Count distinct letters, then apply the parity rule specified by the problem.

title: Stones on the Table
hint: Keep one stone from each maximal run of equal colors.

title: Bear and Big Brother
hint: Simulate complete years until the first weight becomes strictly larger.

title: Nearly Lucky Number
hint: Count occurrences of 4 and 7.

title: Queue at the School
hint: Process disjoint BG pairs in each second.

title: Football
hint: Track the length of the equal-character run ending at the current position.

title: Magnets
hint: A new group starts exactly when the orientation changes from the previous magnet.

title: George and Accommodation
hint: A room can accommodate both friends exactly when capacity minus occupancy is at least two.

title: In Search of an Easy Problem
hint: The decision is the logical OR of all opinions.

title: Anton and Danik
hint: Count Anton wins and compare with the remaining games, which Danik won.

title: Drinks
hint: Equal drink volumes make the final percentage the arithmetic mean.

title: Is your horseshoe on the other hoof?
hint: Keep one horseshoe of each existing color.

title: Hulk
hint: Alternate the two clauses by index parity.

title: Insomnia cure
hint: Test whether each dragon index is divisible by at least one attack interval.

title: I Wanna Be the Guy
hint: Mark every level either player can pass.

title: Games
hint: Enumerate every ordered host and visitor pair.

title: Translation
hint: Reverse the first word and compare the complete strings.

title: Pangram
hint: Normalize each letter to lowercase and mark its alphabet position.

title: Anton and Letters
hint: Ignore punctuation and spaces, marking only lowercase letters.

title: HQ9+
hint: Only H, Q, and 9 produce output in this language.

title: Lucky Division
hint: Enumerate every lucky number no larger than the input limit.

title: Even Odds
hint: There are ceil(n/2) odd numbers before the even block.

title: Calculating Function
hint: Pair consecutive terms as -1+2, -3+4, and so on.

title: Hit the Lottery
hint: Take denominations from largest to smallest.

title: Sum of Round Numbers
hint: Use one summand for each nonzero decimal digit at its original place value.

title: Divisibility Problem
hint: Only the remainder of a modulo b matters.

title: Holiday Of Equality
hint: Nobody can lose money, so the common final wealth must be at least the current maximum.

title: Vasya the Hipster
hint: Each mixed-color day consumes one sock of each color, so the smaller count bounds and attains the maximum.

title: Choosing Teams
hint: A student can participate in the planned contests exactly when their previous count plus k is at most five.

title: Soft Drinking
hint: Compute how many individual toasts each resource can support.

title: Design Tutorial: Learn from Math
hint: Choose four for an even total and nine for an odd total.

title: IQ test
hint: Count odd values to identify the minority parity.

title: Gravity Flip
hint: At every row, rightward gravity packs occupied cells against the right wall.

title: Puzzles
hint: Sort puzzle sizes and examine consecutive blocks of n choices.

title: Twins
hint: For any fixed count, the largest coins maximize the money taken.

title: Dragons
hint: Fight dragons in increasing strength order.

title: Vanya and Cubes
hint: Successive levels require triangular numbers of cubes.

title: Vanya and Fence
hint: Each person independently contributes width two if taller than the fence and width one otherwise.

title: Mishka and Game
hint: Maintain the difference in round wins, adding one for a first-player win and subtracting one for a second-player win.

title: Presents
hint: Invert the permutation of gift recipients.

title: Beautiful Year
hint: Try years in increasing order, beginning strictly after the input.

title: Ultra-Fast Mathematician
hint: Apply exclusive OR independently to corresponding bits.

title: Young Physicist
hint: Add force vectors component by component.

title: Arrival of the General
hint: Use the leftmost maximum and rightmost minimum to minimize their travel.

title: I_love_%username%
hint: Maintain the minimum and maximum of earlier scores.

title: Gennady and a Card Game
hint: Check each card for a matching rank or a matching suit.

title: Restoring Three Numbers
hint: Positive hidden numbers make their total the largest given sum.

title: Collecting Coins
hint: The final equal amount must be the total divided by three.

title: Required Remainder
hint: All valid values have the form y plus a nonnegative multiple of x.

title: Multiply by 2, divide by 6
hint: Only factors two and three can be removed.

title: Short Substrings
hint: The first bigram contributes both initial letters; each following bigram contributes only its final letter because its first letter repeats the previous endpoint.

title: Even Array
hint: A swap between an incorrect even-indexed position and an incorrect odd-indexed position fixes both.

title: Social Distance
hint: Place a new person at the earliest seat sufficiently far from the previous person and the next original person.
